info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Historical Analytics APIs API

params.name: from
params.description: UTC date starting from which the data needs to be returned.

params.name: to
params.description: UTC date up to which the data needs to be returned

items.docs:
Returns daily aggregates of various metrics related to Webex messaging.
The base URL for these APIs is **analytics.webexapis.com**, which does not work with the **Try It** feature.

The base URL for these APIs is **analytics.webexapis.com**, which does not work with the **Try It** feature.
